title: EOS benchmark ledger
description: benchmark/results/ledger.json, the final measured state of the v1-against-v2 line. Append only: score.py refuses duplicate run_id values and nothing is ever rewritten. The benchmark is retired under ADR-0007 and no further rows will be written, so this schema documents the frozen ledger rather than gating anything: no check loads it. It was written from score.py's row shape and did not match the ledger on five points, all corrected here against the file.

run_id.description: Unique across the ledger; enforced at append time.

variant.description: The process surface the session ran under. The pilot rows say v1 or v2; the 2026-08-08 batch dates its labels (v1-2026-08-08, v2-2026-08-08) and the ablation arms name themselves (v2-no-router, v2-routed-once, timing-alongside, timing-acceptance-first, timing-harden-last). An enum of v1 and v2 rejected 178 of the 275 rows.

ablation.description: Policy or timing ablation label (for example no-router, wip1), null for headline runs.

model.description: Pinned for the whole comparison; changing model voids it and requires re-baseline.

source.description: reused marks a row admitted from an identical-setting headline run rather than a new session; savings recorded, not assumed.

operator_events.description: Harness-recorded events only: AskUserQuestion invocations and permission or approval events from transcripts.

human_gates_pending.description: Human gates still outstanding when the run ended: work the process left awaiting operator approval. Reported beside quality criteria, never folded into them.

criteria_sha256.description: Criterion id to the sha256 of the grader script that produced the verdict, so a row says which grader judged it.

scored_at.description: When score.py wrote the row, ISO 8601 with offset. date is the run's day; this is the scoring instant.

supersedes.description: run_id of an earlier row this one replaces after a re-score. The earlier row stays in the ledger and gains superseded_by, because append-only means corrected in place is not available.

superseded_by.description: run_id of the row that replaced this one. The pair is written together; seventeen rows carry each side.
